description: Scoring two donor-prediction rules against the benchmark and testing the column-256 basic residue against NADPH preference
code:
# Formal evaluation of two decision rules on the benchmark, and a contingency test.
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

# results carried over from the previous block (recomputed there from UniProt; listed here verbatim)
B = [  # name, known donor, col216, col244, col256
 ("hCYB5R3",       "NADH",  "Q211", "D240", "F252"),
 ("ratCYB5R3",     "NADH",  "Q211", "D240", "F252"),
 ("Cbr1 yeast",    "NADH",  "V185", "D214", "Y227"),
 ("Mcr1 yeast",    "NADH",  "K198", "D228", "F241"),
 ("Ncb5or human",  "both",  "K429", "S457", "H469"),
 ("NR maize",      "NADH",  "R796", "Q826", "I839"),
 ("NR Arabidopsis","NADH",  "R825", "E854", "F866"),
 ("NR N. crassa",  "NADPH", "R889", "S920", "R932"),
 ("NR A. nidulans","NADPH", "R782", "T813", "R825"),
 ("Pga3/Nqr1",     "NADH",  "E216", "H244", "Y256"),
 ("AIM33",         "?",     "E216", "H244", "Y256"),
]
acid, basic = set("DE"), set("KR")
aa = lambda s: s[0]

def rule_A(r):   # symmetric rule over columns 216 and 244 (the rule stated in the seed hypothesis)
    p = [aa(r[2]), aa(r[3])]
    a, b = any(c in acid for c in p), any(c in basic for c in p)
    return "NADH" if a and not b else "NADPH" if b and not a else "mixed" if a and b else "neutral"

def rule_B(r):   # positional rule: 256 and 244 carry the NADPH signal, 216 and 244 the NADH signal
    c216, c244, c256 = aa(r[2]), aa(r[3]), aa(r[4])
    if c244 in basic or c256 in basic: return "NADPH"
    if c244 in acid or c216 in acid:   return "NADH"
    return "neutral"

known = [r for r in B if r[1] in ("NADH", "NADPH")]
for nm, f in (("rule A (seed, symmetric over 216/244)", rule_A), ("rule B (positional, 256+244 basic = NADPH)", rule_B)):
    corr = sum(1 for r in known if f(r) == r[1])
    inv  = sum(1 for r in known if f(r) in ("NADH", "NADPH") and f(r) != r[1])
    abst = sum(1 for r in known if f(r) in ("neutral", "mixed"))
    print(f"{nm:44s} correct {corr}/{len(known)}, inverted {inv}, abstained {abst}")
print()
print(f"{'protein':16s} {'known':6s} {'216':>6s} {'244':>6s} {'256':>6s}  {'ruleA':>8s} {'ruleB':>8s}")
for r in B:
    print(f"{r[0]:16s} {r[1]:6s} {r[2]:>6s} {r[3]:>6s} {r[4]:>6s}  {rule_A(r):>8s} {rule_B(r):>8s}")

# contingency: basic residue at column 256 vs known NADPH preference
tab = [[0, 0], [0, 0]]
for r in known:
    i = 0 if aa(r[4]) in basic else 1
    j = 0 if r[1] == "NADPH" else 1
    tab[i][j] += 1
odds, p = fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"\nBasic residue at column 256 vs NADPH preference, 2x2 = {tab}, Fisher exact p = {p:.4f}")
print("  (both NADPH enzymes carry Arg there; none of the 7 NADH enzymes does)")
print(f"\nAIM33 and Pga3 share the identical triad E216/H244/Y256. Pga3 is experimentally NADH.")

# figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.4))
rows = B[::-1]
for k, r in enumerate(rows):
    ax.text(-0.35, k, r[0], ha="right", va="center", fontsize=9.5,
            fontweight="bold" if r[0] in ("AIM33", "Pga3/Nqr1") else "normal")
    for c, cell in enumerate(r[2:5]):
        a = aa(cell)
        col = "#c6d9f0" if a in acid else ("#f6c6c6" if a in basic else "#ededed")
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((c, k-0.42), 0.94, 0.84, color=col, ec="white", lw=1.5))
        ax.text(c+0.47, k, cell, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9)
    kc = {"NADH": "#1f4e79", "NADPH": "#c00000", "both": "#7b5ea7", "?": "#666666"}[r[1]]
    ax.text(3.3, k, r[1], ha="left", va="center", fontsize=9.5, color=kc, fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(4.5, k, rule_B(r), ha="left", va="center", fontsize=9.5, style="italic",
            color="#1f4e79" if rule_B(r) == "NADH" else "#c00000" if rule_B(r) == "NADPH" else "#666666")
for c, t in enumerate(["col 216", "col 244\n(rat D239)", "col 256\n(rat F251)"]):
    ax.text(c+0.47, len(rows)-0.15, t, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9)
ax.text(3.3, len(rows)-0.15, "known donor", ha="left", va="bottom", fontsize=9)
ax.text(4.5, len(rows)-0.15, "positional rule", ha="left", va="bottom", fontsize=9)
ax.axhline(len(rows)-1.5, color="#999999", lw=1, ls="--", xmin=0.05, xmax=0.98)
ax.set_xlim(-4.6, 6.0); ax.set_ylim(-0.9, len(rows)+1.1); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("Donor-determinant columns across transhydrogenase-fold reductases with known preference.\n"
             "Blue = Asp or Glu, red = Lys or Arg. Both NADPH enzymes carry Arg at column 256;\n"
             "AIM33 matches its NADH-using ohnolog Pga3 residue for residue.", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
